milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The hay blocks are inside the barn at approximately x5, y2, z6 (center of the hay block cluster at x4-6, y1-2, z5-7). The player must navigate near the hay blocks and face them to demonstrate they have found them. Max distance 16 allows finding them from the barn entrance.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The ladder is at x5, y1-5, z7 (hidden behind the hay blocks). The player must get closer (max_distance 5) to demonstrate they actually found the ladder behind the hay, not just looked in its general direction from far away. Target is set at y3 (middle of the ladder column).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The polished blackstone brick stairs are at approximately x-3, y1, z5 (center of the 6-stair arrangement at x-2 to x-4, y1, z4-5). The player must navigate near them and face them. Max distance 16 allows finding them from the spawn area since they are clearly visible outside.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because this is a build/place task. The player must place polished_blackstone_bricks blocks in the upper level of the barn (x4-9, y4-5, z4-9) to construct walls for a hidden room. A minimum of 6 blocks indicates meaningful wall construction (enough for at least partial enclosure). The box is generous (±3 around center) to accommodate various room placements on the upper level.
